headline: Southwest US Flooding Escalates to Active Warnings in Arizona as San Juan River Devastates Utah Communities on Halloween
overview: A prolonged and expanding weather system continues to pummel the American Southwest and Southern California on October 31, with active flood warnings now hitting the Salt River in metropolitan Phoenix and the San Juan River causing humanitarian devastation in Bluff, Utah and Navajo Nation communities. Globally, Indonesia's Merapi volcano sustains an active eruption on Java, while Kīlauea's anticipated Episode 56 lava fountain window formally opens today. Alaska's Skagway corridor faces its first significant winter storm of the season, and El Niño-driven coastal flooding is pushing California water levels to historic highs.

events.title: Southwest US Flooding Escalates — Salt River, Tonto Creek, and San Juan River Under Active Warnings
events.location: Arizona, Utah, New Mexico, Colorado, USA
events.summary: Active Flood Warnings are in effect for Maricopa and Gila Counties in Arizona, with the Salt River rising below Granite Reef Dam and Tonto Creek flooding low-water crossings. Broad Flood Watches extend across most of Arizona, southern Utah, southwest Colorado, and northwest New Mexico, with the storm system expected to persist through Monday. The San Juan River in Bluff, Utah has caused severe humanitarian impact, forcing evacuations and inundating homes in Navajo Nation communities, with local officials describing conditions as 'devastating.'

articles.title: Most of Arizona, including the Valley, is under a Flood Watch this weekend

events.title: Florida Keys Major Coastal Flood Warning — 'Numerous Roads May Be Closed' Through Sunday
events.location: Florida Keys and Northeast Florida, USA
events.summary: NWS Key West has issued a Coastal Flood Warning for the Upper Florida Keys through early Sunday morning, warning of 'major saltwater flooding' with numerous road closures expected and low-lying homes and businesses inundated. A separate Coastal Flood Warning remains active for Eastern Putnam County near the St. Johns River through Sunday, and a Flood Warning for Lake and Volusia Counties along the St. Johns River continues, reflecting the breadth of Florida's coastal flood crisis. King tides and persistent northeast winds are compounding flood levels across the state.

articles.title: Record coastal flooding continues in Florida Keys
Strong king tides cause major saltwater flooding in the Florida Keys

events.title: Merapi Volcano Sustains Active Eruption — Ongoing Lava Dome Activity on Java
events.summary: Indonesia's Mount Merapi, one of the world's most active volcanoes at 2,910 meters elevation on Java, continued its eruption through the week of October 22–28, with PVMBG (Indonesia's Center for Volcanology and Geological Hazard Mitigation) actively monitoring ongoing activity. The weekly volcanic activity report confirmed sustained eruptive behavior during this period. Merapi's proximity to densely populated areas, including the city of Yogyakarta, makes any escalation a serious public safety concern.

events.title: Kīlauea Episode 56 Lava Fountain Window Opens — Eruption Expected Oct. 31–Nov. 6
events.summary: Today, October 31, marks the opening of the USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory's forecast window for Kīlauea's Episode 56 high lava fountaining event, with activity expected anytime between now and November 6. Summit inflation had stalled earlier in the week, pushing the window back by one day, but conditions are now considered ripe for the next eruptive episode. Residents and visitors near Kīlauea caldera are advised to monitor HVO updates closely as fountaining could begin with little additional warning.

events.title: El Niño Coastal Flooding Hits Southern California — Historic Water Levels and Halloween Rain
events.summary: Southern California is experiencing its first Halloween rainfall since 2014, with Los Angeles recording 30.6mm of precipitation today amid a broader El Niño-driven coastal flood emergency. NOAA data shows observed water levels surpassing minor flooding thresholds along the La Jolla and Orange County coasts, with Pacific Coast Highway in Sunset Beach flooded by high tides and waves. Record-hot ocean temperatures linked to El Niño are amplifying wave heights and tidal surge, threatening beachfront infrastructure up and down the coast.

articles.title: El Niño-linked waves push California water levels to historic highs

events.title: Skagway Winter Storm Warning — Klondike Highway Buried Under Up to 14 Inches of Snow
events.location: Skagway and White Pass, Alaska, USA
events.summary: A Winter Storm Warning is in effect for Skagway and the Klondike Highway including White Pass from this morning through 9 AM Sunday, with 9 to 14 inches of snow expected and wind gusts to 40 mph creating blowing snow conditions. The Klondike Highway — a critical supply and tourism route connecting Skagway to Yukon, Canada — faces travel conditions described as 'very difficult to impossible.' This marks the first significant winter storm headline of the 2026–27 season for Alaska's panhandle.

articles.title: Klondike Highway Travel Disrupted Over White Pass on Oct. 31

events.title: M6.5 Deep Earthquake Strikes Bonin Islands, Japan — No Tsunami Warning Issued
events.summary: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck the Bonin Islands region of Japan on October 25 at a depth of 492 km, making it a deep-focus event that significantly limited surface shaking and tsunami risk. Despite the USGS flagging a tsunami alert status, no tsunami warning was ultimately issued, and the USGS assigned a green alert level indicating low likelihood of casualties or significant damage. The earthquake was felt by at least one person, and its epicenter was located approximately 729 km from the nearest major population center.
